doc_name: 国务院反垄断委员会关于平台经济领域的反垄断指南
quote_zh: 为了预防和制止平台经济领域垄断行为，保护市场公平竞争
quote_en: To prevent and stop monopolistic conduct in the platform economy and protect fair market competition.
notes: Dedicated antitrust guideline: monopoly agreements, abuse of dominance (二选一, big-data price discrimination, below-cost sales), merger review incl. VIE structures and start-up platforms. The same sentence adds 促进平台经济规范有序创新健康发展 (neutral side). Mapping to 互联网电商 is a judgement.
